purpose: Independently verify the fixed joint-family inventory/count design and its owned series integration without claiming completed scientific calibration.

authority.meaning_preserved: No m=1 exception; fixed 256-world final denominators and adopted exact one-sided thresholds remain unchanged.

findings.before: Raw registry envelopes have no id field. The collision inventory yielded those envelopes and failed on artifact identity access.
findings.after: The scanner uses Broker._artifact(row.id), verifying stored identity and retaining IDs for development/final/standalone input kinds.

findings.before: Count extraction discarded a known True event whenever another component made the aggregate state technical/model failure.
findings.after: The pure count mapper consumes validated events; known union errors survive unknown siblings while missing required observations remain unavailable.

findings.before: A calculation with a technical sibling can intentionally return before replay. Its partial VERIFIED component must not become owned calibrated evidence.
findings.after: The shared runner retains the raw partial result/proof but settles every family component unavailable through the shared failure factory. This prevents the pure mapper fix from counting unreplayed partial outputs.

reviewed_invariants: Every pattern contains the assigned distinct response count; all homogeneous effects and a genuinely mixed vector are mandatory. Unsupported/oversized profiles fail rather than truncate.
One spec/vector/replicate is one jointly generated world, never one replicate per component. Final cohorts each expand to the same 256 world IDs for that group.
Null-support and boundary-decision unions use only their applicable components; detection remains per planted response; every group also has joint coverage.
Compact cohort descriptors and shared world groups avoid duplicated event requests. The unchanged evaluate_cohort applies all thresholds; every required cohort must complete and pass.

The final identity retains numerical pattern structure under bounded response-column permutation while removing labels/rationale/provenance aliases. Existing final requests cannot reset seed, budget, cost or applicability.
Recorded seed collision checks include retained development/final inventories and standalone population/family capsules, including failed and reserved work.
The existing retained-source execution/replay, per-attempt reservation, orphan recovery, dependency revocation and source currency paths are reused.

New family input/attempt schemas are host-reserved, creation-time-aware and in the typed revocation graph. Final operations ancestry is denied to discovery/formalization even through wrappers and the private-target exception.
Old numerical policy and single-claim count schemas remain unchanged; only explicit new family manifest schemas dispatch to family behavior.

checks.oracle_timing: The 13 fixed expectations were authored before reading the new production module. Production existed by first execution. Two selector fields were corrected from id to cohort_id without changing any numerical oracle; that failure is not claimed as a production defect.
checks.red_green: The later 10-case adversarial run showed exactly two assertion failures and one KeyError. The same tests pass after the three production corrections; no expected scientific result was weakened.

fixed_oracles.boundary_union: 17 worlds with two erroneous supports plus 17 worlds with one erroneous negative yield 34 error worlds, not 51 component events.
fixed_oracles.missing_failure: Missing replicate 5 and failed replicate 7 retain planned=256, observed=254 and point=null in every affected cohort.
fixed_oracles.development_target: One planted component below four-fifths prevents nomination of the smaller target despite successful siblings.

actual_lifecycle_status_at_review: Parent-owned real four-cell development plus one final-world replay and recovery tests were still pending at review creation. Their source was reviewed, but no execution success from that pending run is claimed here.

resource_boundary.qualification: Illustrative scaling of the earlier observed workload, not a guarantee that every scenario has identical size. Even raw-stream storage at that scale exceeds the current envelope before replay/materialization. No practical complete-series feasibility is established; resource-stop remains an honest outcome.

limitations: The 23 current tests include synthetic count records and host metadata plus mocked calculator results; they isolate invariants and do not themselves authenticate a complete generated series.
No complete 256-world-per-cell final assessment, real-market validity, model adequacy, heterogeneous original-AST truth coupling or full-process calibration is demonstrated.
Distinct deterministic PRNG seeds do not prove ideal statistical independence. Applicability declarations remain unverified.
No scientific freeze/allocation, protected market-outcome execution, N_min, profitability or live-capital authority follows.
Long-running parent lifecycle/legacy regression runs are intentionally excluded until their terminal outputs exist. This is not a full repository suite.
next_action: Complete the pending actual lifecycle and legacy regression checks against these source hashes, retain any failures, and qualify full-series resource feasibility before claiming an executable complete calibration workload.
